work_context.role_department: Senior Sales Representative, West Coast Region
work_context.career_stage: Mid-career professional with 8 years experience. Looking to advance to sales management role within 2 years. High performer consistently exceeding quota.
work_context.work_style: Collaborative team player who prefers face-to-face meetings for important deals. Uses mobile tools extensively while traveling. Values quick access to customer information and sales materials.
work_context.performance_context: Measured on quarterly sales targets, customer satisfaction scores, and pipeline development. Performance reviews every 6 months. Participates in leadership development program.
work_context.change_readiness: Generally positive about new tools that improve efficiency. Prefers hands-on training and peer learning. Can be resistant to changes that slow down her current workflow.

legacy.custom_fields: Mentors new sales hires. Active in company diversity and inclusion initiatives. Frequently provides feedback on sales tools and processes.
